integrity: All probabilistic laws and integrability thresholds are established analytically. Finite numerical checks are reproducibility checks and do not prove infinite-moment statements. Gaussian quotient and order-statistic tools are standard prior mathematics.
scientific_limitations: Exact results require Hermitian A, an invariant spectator subspace, independent square complex-Gaussian sketches, a nonzero Ritz residual, and the distinguished non-spectator root; neither general Ritz-root selection nor superiority to deterministic Rayleigh-quotient refinement is claimed.
title: Three independent Gaussian Ritz sketches recover the exact residual mean-square scale
